domain-information: A transportation manager reviews the transport schedule and assigns delivery routes to dispatchers.
A transportation manager evaluates performance reports from dispatchers to ensure operational efficiency.
A dispatcher reviews client transport requests and assigns vehicles based on capacity.
A dispatcher coordinates with security officers to plan secure cargo escorts for high-value deliveries.
A driver checks assigned delivery routes before departure.
A driver conducts a vehicle inspection and reports any maintenance needs before leaving.
A driver completes the delivery log and submits it to the dispatcher after returning from the route.
A security officer inspects cargo before loading to confirm proper sealing and documentation.
A security officer escorts a vehicle during transport to ensure the safety of valuable goods.
A security officer reports security incidents during transit to the dispatcher.
A maintenance technician performs regular maintenance on vehicles to prevent breakdowns.
A maintenance technician updates maintenance records of the vehicle.

domain objects.name: Transportation Manager
domain objects.description: Oversees transport operations, assigns routes, and evaluates performance.

domain objects.name: Transport Schedule
domain objects.description: Plan outlining all delivery routes and assigned resources.

domain objects.name: Delivery Route
domain objects.description: Specific path assigned to a vehicle and driver for a delivery.

domain objects.name: Delivery Log
domain objects.description: Record of trip details including times, stops, and cargo status.

domain objects.name: Vehicle
domain objects.description: Transport unit used for deliveries.

domain objects.name: Capacity
domain objects.description: Maximum load a vehicle can carry.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Records
domain objects.description: Historical record of maintenance performed on a vehicle.

domain objects.name: Dispatcher
domain objects.description: Coordinates routes, assigns vehicles, and monitors ongoing deliveries.

domain objects.name: Performance Report
domain objects.description: Report summarizing delivery efficiency and performance metrics.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Company or entity requesting transportation services.

domain objects.name: Transport Request
domain objects.description: Request from a client specifying cargo and destination details.

domain objects.name: Security Officer
domain objects.description: Ensures cargo safety through inspection and escort operations.

domain objects.name: Cargo Escort
domain objects.description: Security operation accompanying valuable cargo during transport.

domain objects.name: Cargo Inspection
domain objects.description: Security check verifying cargo integrity before loading.

domain objects.name: Security Incident
domain objects.description: Event or report describing a breach or safety issue during transport.

domain objects.name: Driver
domain objects.description: Operates the vehicle to complete assigned delivery routes.

domain objects.name: Vehicle Inspection
domain objects.description: Driver-conducted check of vehicle condition before departure.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Issue
domain objects.description: Problem identified during inspection or operation requiring repair.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Technician
domain objects.description: Performs vehicle maintenance and repairs.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Task
domain objects.description: Scheduled or corrective maintenance action performed on a vehicle.
